newsitem.title: USA: Millennium Chemicals sets Q1 dividend. [CORRECTED 00:02 GMT 24/1]
newsitem.headline: Millennium Chemicals sets Q1 dividend. [CORRECTED 00:02 GMT 24/1]

text.p: Millenium Chemicals Inc said Thursday it had declared an initial quarterly common stock dividend.
The dividend is equal to $0.15 a share, when grossed up for the $0.03 U.K. advanced corporation tax, or $0.12 net (corrects from $0.02 net) to U.S. holders, the company said.
The dividend is payable March 31, record March 14.
U.K.-based shareholders will receive sterling checks net of an additional 15 percent U.S. withholding on the dividend, it said.
The dividend will not be a foreign income dividend for U.K. tax purposes, it said.
Millennium was spun-off from Hanson Plc and began trading as an independent public company on October 2.
